identifier.reasoning: These are statistical identifiers or taxonomic groups, not specific insect specimens.
identifier.reasoning_relevance: Names taxonomic ranks or mathematical transformations, not organism traits.

Estimate mean ± SE.reasoning: This column holds the calculated mean and standard error for the statistical model.
Estimate mean ± SE.reasoning_relevance: Represents a statistic (mean and standard error), not a biological trait.

t-statistic.reasoning: This is the statistical measure representing the t-statistic of the test.
t-statistic.reasoning_relevance: Represents a statistical test result, which is not a measurementType.

p.reasoning: This is the statistical measure representing the p-value of the test.
p.reasoning_relevance: Represents a statistical probability value, not a biological trait.
